test_cases.description: Assert that legacy/ directory has been completely deleted from the project filesystem.
Assert that no Python file in core/, central_platform/, app/, local_runtime/, or scripts/ imports from legacy.
Assert that dead enable_legacy_agents flag is removed from core.config.FEATURE_FLAGS.
Assert that stale scratch analysis scripts and temp sqlite DBs are removed from scratch/.
Verify primary core modules (config, session, mode, orchestrator, inference, providers) import cleanly without legacy errors.
Verify primary central platform modules (courses, curriculum, rag, ai gateway, context_builder, tools, tutor orchestrator) import cleanly.
Verify app controllers and local runtime modules import cleanly.
Verify core inference service instantiates and provides active providers without legacy agents or sys.modules pollution.
Verify context message assembly operates with high fidelity without legacy agent dependencies.
Verify FastAPI platform starts up and passes /healthz, /readyz, and /livez health check probes.
Verify sys.modules and top-level packages contains zero legacy modules.
Verify GenericTutorOrchestrator turn execution succeeds without any legacy path invocation.
